parent: WPF-MATURE-05, existing01/02/03/05; no new execution layer
kind: Read-only Arc layout/Recovery interface refinement; no claim or implementation

newDesignConstraints.source: App renders tab bodies inside groups.map, while official ConversationThread owns pending submission refs/runtime and useConversationStream creates its host in component useMemo. Recovery retains separate namespace/session/client and stable view key.
newDesignConstraints.proposal: Use one stable rendering parent for all layout-referenced chat views, keyed by existing view.key; reorder sibling panels for visual and DOM reading order. Top-level tabs describe arrays of pane references, not new ConversationProjection or client owners. Keep the Workspace/Recovery owner mounted across layout moves. This is a proposal; actual focus/selection/scroll and pending handoff behavior must be browser-tested.

newDesignConstraints.source: Current App permits closed protected views in its private views map; the resident cap is32. Recovery draft/command blockers must prevent silent disposal.
newDesignConstraints.proposal: Rendering pool should follow open layout refs, not blindly render every retained view. Explicitly closed-protected views remain in original owner storage and journal, but need not retain full mounted Thread DOM. Split/merge preserve open references; explicit close follows existing protection/release rules; reopening hydrates from the original owner. Layout never cancels a task.

newDesignConstraints.source: New draft routes are renamed to conversation routes while view.key remains stable; Recovery rows identify owner.viewKey/routeId/project.
newDesignConstraints.proposal: Persist only versioned bounded layout references, ratios and active selection under verified namespace. Use view.key as layout identity and resolve route aliases through App; no controllers, frozen requests, auth secrets or copied journal contents. Unknown references remain bounded placeholders. Reconstruct layout refs after authoritative session verification; command replay stays explicit. Avoid minting a second view key for the same restored draft route.

newDesignConstraints.topic: More than two panes needs a complete read-budget argument
newDesignConstraints.source: StreamConnectionBudget limits two host leases; pump retains one lease while loading or hasMore, wakes hosts in insertion order, and may reacquire during the same pump. Reply/queue cache guarantees also depended on two visible panes.
newDesignConstraints.proposal: Keep bounded pane arrays and define the implementation maximum before take. The user three-pane goal remains open. Add a three-visible-pane progress trace with sustained dirty/backlog inputs, hidden/closed release and reconnect; do not infer fairness from acquire<=2. Preserve global memory/cache bounds and check reply/queue body concurrency as well as stream reads. No performance or starvation failure is claimed from source alone.

newDesignConstraints.source: Current public ResourceContext provides global/task/message/composer/workspace/reference, not an explicit conversation/pane layout identity. Existing chat.header sometimes carries latest task identity.
newDesignConstraints.proposal: Keep layout mutations in one private App owner and expose validated pane-targeted commands through P01. Determine whether a scoped view identity needs a coordinated P01 contract extension before claiming public coverage. Never infer pane ownership from globally focused task or label a raw slot marker as an extension point.

acceptance: One selected top-level tab visibly holds A and B, with independent official Thread state; three-pane support remains a separately explicit incomplete requirement until real evidence exists.
Move/swap/merge preserves draft text, selected attachments/knowledge/profile, composer selection, scroll anchor and original pending receipt. No business POST is caused by layout operations.
Manual tab activation, adjacent close focus, accessible splitter limits and narrow390 keyboard behavior are verified in actual App.
Fixed-scope source-only reducers are insufficient for full delivery; actual App consumer and independent review follow unique App write handoff after Recovery.

primarySources.application: React associates state with tree position, type and keys. A key alone does not promise state survives moving to another parent; a stable keyed sibling list is an architecture candidate, not a browser focus guarantee.
Use manual activation when activation entails noticeable work; test real focus and selection semantics rather than adding ARIA roles only.

execution: 0 product imports/tests/HTTP/PG/browser/provider. Research only; no new scope/worker/worktree.
